verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents merchant application statuses like 'Needs Information' and real-time underwriting verifications that can be configured pre-submission, suggesting some requirements-due tracking, but there is no explicit documentation of a tunable minimum-to-start-selling flow tied to payout thresholds. missing for 10: explicit progressive onboarding tiers, payout-threshold gating logic, per-seller configurable minimum data set, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
